lines.text: Justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ and access into grace.
Suffering produces perseverance, then character, then hope, and God poured out His love into our hearts through His angels.
At just the right time Christ died for the ungodly, proving God's love while we were still sinners.
Since we have been justified by His blood, we will be saved from wrath through Him.
Reconciled through the death of His Son, we will be saved through His words, and we rejoice in God.
